title: Nuit (formerly FabricSkyboxes)
description: Allows resource packs to define custom skyboxes.
body:
Formerly known as **FabricSkyBoxes**, **Nuit** is a powerful and flexible custom skybox engine for Minecraft.

It goes far beyond OptiFine’s skybox system, offering rich features like **keyframe-based transitions**, **rotation**, **custom weather rendering**, and full support for both **Fabric** and **NeoForge**.

Design immersive skies with dynamic day/night cycles, custom fog, sunrise/sunset glow, weather-aware rendering, and more, all backed by a robust JSON skybox format.

> **Nuit is currently in beta.** Some features may evolve over time. Feedback is welcome.

**[View the Wiki and Format Documentation](https://wiki.nuit.flashyreese.me/)**  
[Source Code on GitHub](https://github.com/FlashyReese/nuit)

## Features

- Fabric and NeoForge support
- Keyframeable **fade** and **rotation** transitions
- Custom sunrise, sunset, night, and weather rendering
- Fog customization per skybox
- Modular JSON-based skybox format
- Animated textures with optional frame interpolation
- Optimized texture loading and runtime performance

---

## Skybox Format

Nuit uses a custom JSON-based format designed for flexibility and future-proofing.

You can create highly detailed and dynamic skyboxes with precise control over how and when they render.

Learn how to create your own skyboxes in the [Wiki Format Documentation](https://wiki.nuit.flashyreese.me/).

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Can I use OptiFine/MCPatcher skybox packs?**  
Nuit does **not** support those formats natively. Use [Nuit Interop](https://modrinth.com/mod/nuit-interop) to load compatible OptiFine/MCPatcher custom sky resource packs through Nuit.

**Is it modpack friendly?**  
Yes. Nuit is licensed under MIT and fully modpack-compatible.

**What happened to FabricSkyBoxes?**  
FabricSkyBoxes has been rebranded to **Nuit** to reflect its expanded scope beyond Fabric.
